correctness.rationale: Exact Schur character expansion checked symbolically gives both universal moment coefficients and variance. The spectral lemma is reconstructed using stationary cubic roots and the invariant zero-sum three-vector fourth norm, reducing all extrema to two-valued spectra. Direct optimization over their integer multiplicities gives all sharp endpoints. The sign boundary and the compact-group averaging argument complete the exact norm and Banach--Mazur formulas. Pell identities prove infinitely many flat pairs; exact checker and independent rank-one Dirichlet cross-check corroborate critical algebra. Finite loops do not replace the universal spectral proof.

value.rationale: The full all-rank/all-dimension sharp classification gives two distinct spectral phases and an infinite family of nontrivial exactly Hilbertian L4 subspaces. The integer resonance condition is motivated by vanishing spectral anisotropy of the natural unitary-conjugation orbit; the exact norm distortion provides a new structural invariant for every other rank. No unmotivated finite cutoff or incremental one-rank variation is involved.
